tonight.headline: Lamb and Pierce need 20.75 to beat you
body: Bad news first: the lead shrank overnight. Josh Jacobs scored 20.1 for JuiceJam and the Seahawks D/ST 10, the Broncos D/ST faded from 8 to 4, and Wilson (4.6), Likely (3.2) and Metcalf (7.6) never recovered. You lead 89.76 to 69.02, every AVIATO player is final, and ESPN now favours JuiceJam at 65%.
They need 20.75 from CeeDee Lamb (projected 18.6) and Dameon Pierce (6.9) in Dallas–Philadelphia, 18:15 CDMX tonight. You can do nothing about it.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Their projections alone get there: Lamb 18.6 plus Pierce 6.9 is 25.5 against the 20.75 they need. Pierce's share grows if Saquon Barkley (hamstring, questionable, 'trending in the right direction' — Footballguys 26 Oct) sits or leaves early.

case.label: The script that saves it
case.body: Barkley plays a full load and Pierce stays a few-touch backup, while Lamb lands under his projection. Lamb faces a Philadelphia defence, not its offence — the Eagles' missing receivers (DeVonta Smith, Wicks) and Hurts on IR with McKee starting (Yahoo 25 Oct) bear on game script, not on his targets.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley inactive at 16:45 CDMX — then Pierce is Philadelphia's lead back and the 35% is generous.

case.body: Josh Allen (254.2 rest-of-season, ESPN) returns from the bye; Jordan Love (200.2) was added on 15 Oct for this one week. One quarterback starts in Chem.

case.label: The rest of Week 8
case.body: Likely (Giants), Fairbairn (Texans) and Kamara (Saints) are on bye in Week 8; Tuten and Diggs return. Tuesday's run sets the RB/WR slots and the tight-end and kicker covers on Week 8 projections — Hockenson and Hunter Henry lead the tight-end list, AJ Barner (free agent, Seattle's lead tight end since Arroyo's season-ending IR) is the no-claim option.

case.label: Why a card now
case.body: Every Chem player is final; this is the only lineup move left and it cannot be made until the week rolls. Carried from Sunday unchanged.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love outscores Allen in Week 8 (archive) — graded on the outcome. Allen injured before Week 8 voids it.
